light_description: Dynamic gain pedal spanning clean boost, touch-sensitive overdrive, distortion and full fuzz saturation; the builder describes a two-stage gain architecture with broad shaping control.
Fuzz and fuzzy driver designed for a wide range of textured gain sounds, from light fuzz-as-overdrive through saturated and aggressive fuzz.
Gain pedal designed to tighten amplifier attack while covering clean-ish singing blues tones through crunchy rhythm and heavily driven lead sounds.
Vintage-voiced fuzz with Tight control for changing pick response from smooth and thick to tight and aggressive, plus tone shaping and boost/germanium-silicon options.
High-gain distortion designed around tight, focused attack and modern heavy tones.
Rock-oriented distortion from the Tight series, built around controlled low end and adjustable attack.
Blues-oriented fuzz combining saturated fuzz character with usable dynamics and gain control.
Booster, overdrive and distortion pedal intended to deliver dynamic, responsive and powerful gain tones.
Fuzz pedal built around a broad, expressive saturated sound and Caroline's distinctive gain character.
High-gain fuzz with a parallel octave-up voice, combining strong sustain, clarity and aggressive harmonic content.
IC-based fuzz and octave pedal combining a powerful fuzz voice with an octave-up effect and a more controlled modern presentation.
Two-mode overdrive that ranges from transparent always-on light drive to a rougher, more aggressive raw drive.
Dynamic drive pedal intended to cover a range of amp-like overdrive textures with flexible response.
Two-style gain pedal combining a preamp-like drive voice with a power-amp-style clipping voice; designed as a more conventional Caroline overdrive with broad dynamic range.
A resonant-filtered gain pedal whose sound can move from singing sustain and overdrive into aggressive fuzz and distortion, with a pronounced fixed-wah or cocked-wah character.
Pocket-size gain family spanning germanium booster/overdrive and FET distortion variants, with successive Mk generations documented.
Harmonic octave distortion/fuzz inspired by the classic bass octave-fuzz concept, with control over harmonics, sensitivity and wet/dry balance.
Multi-stage gain pedal combining touch-sensitive overdrive, fuzz, filters and octave-up processing, with parallel fuzz and overdrive paths for large gain combinations.
Low-to-medium-gain amplifier-style overdrive ranging from clean boost and light breakup to harmonic-rich overdrive, with interactive drive and tone controls.
Gain pedal covering edge-of-breakup boost, classic grit and thick overdrive through raspy, splatty and textural fuzz sounds.
MOSFET overdrive and fuzz designed to cover raw low-gain breakup through rugged full-range fuzz, with emphasis on texture, fizz and saturation.
Early Japanese FET overdrive intended to reproduce the sound of an amplifier being driven beyond normal operating level, with simple level and emphasis controls.
Early Japanese overdrive associated with the Coron OEM family, covering amplifier-like breakup from mild drive through gritty saturation.
